subject: gk
question:
Read the following statements about Money.

A. Money also acts as a convenient unit of account.

B. The value of all goods and services can be expressed in monetary units.

Identify the CORRECT statement/statements.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and B**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Both statements A and B about money are correct.
 
• **Statement A**: Money acts as a convenient unit of account, meaning it provides a standard numerical unit of measurement for the market value of goods, services, and other transactions.
 
• **Statement B**: The value of all goods and services can be expressed in monetary units, which simplifies the process of comparing prices and costs in an economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Money serves several functions in an economy, including being a medium of exchange, a store of value, and a unit of account.
 
• As a unit of account, money allows for the consistent valuation and comparison of goods and services, facilitating trade and economic planning.
 
• The use of money as a unit of account is essential for budgeting, accounting, and financial reporting.
 
• Without a common unit of account, it would be challenging to measure and compare the value of different goods and services, complicating economic transactions.
